source.title: Efficacy and safety of bronchial artery embolization in the treatment of hemoptysis: a systematic review and meta-analysis of RCTs.

whyItFits: Open meta-analysis of randomised trials of bronchial artery embolization for haemoptysis, including studies of massive haemoptysis.
limitations: BAE outcome meta-analysis. Not a complete resuscitation protocol for massive haemoptysis.
